construction.method: Exact radical coordinates and a fixed hinge tree; no iterative layout.

solid.coordinate_system: right-handed xyz, centered at the origin

net.coordinate_system: xy, x right, y up; unit edge length
net.bottom_order_note: Pairs reverse locally, keeping squares opposite on strip faces 1, 3, 5.
net.assembly: Fold dashed edges; join equal solid_edge cut labels, matching solid_vertex endpoints.
